principles.fiction_required: Every situational Advantage or Disadvantage must have a concrete reason the table can state.

pool_effect.note: This authority preserves existing d4/d6 Advantage/Disadvantage references without inventing a universal die size. The final interaction rule for multiple simultaneous Advantage/Disadvantage sources remains unresolved until explicitly locked.

interaction.evaluator_behavior_until_locked: Collect and display every named source separately; do not silently cancel, merge, or manufacture dice. If more than one Advantage/Disadvantage source would affect a roll and no explicit rule resolves the interaction, require GM resolution before rolling.

prohibitions: Do not label Gear dice as Advantage.
Do not label VAM-added dice as Advantage unless the VAM explicitly grants Advantage.
Do not label Mastery as Advantage.
Do not convert a situational judgment into a numeric +N modifier.
Do not create an unexplained extra die.

examples.reason: Target is unaware due to a successful ambush
Heavy smoke materially obscures the target
